name: entmax
role: fp64 CPU reference for the entmax/sparsemax routing primitive -- the crown-jewel producer reference every Tier 1 routing gate is anchored to
measured_under_this_version: the 1.421e-14 worst continuous difference (dual run, NEW=tip OLD=033fa7d, quantity w256-s30.0-dense-a1.5/tau) quoted in reference.py's module header, the audit and PRODUCER_ATOL's derivation was measured against THIS version. A version bump changes what that figure describes.
why_this_is_the_only_guard: the dual-run protocol (tools/oracle_dual_run.py) runs OLD and NEW as two commits of THIS repository; both sides import the SAME installed `entmax`. A dependency bump that changes entmax15's tie-breaking or entmax_bisect's semantics moves every routing gate's anchor and produces a dual run with nothing to compare against, because there is no OLD entmax to diff against the NEW one. This pin -- checked at reference.py's import site -- is the only thing in this tree that can refuse that drift.
package_root: the installed `entmax` package directory (`Path(entmax.__file__).parent`), not a vendored subtree -- there is nothing to vendor for a pure-python test dependency, so the pin is re-checked against pip's install rather than against a copy in this repository
package_sha256_recipe: sha256 over sorted relative POSIX paths of the installed package directory, each followed by a NUL and by the sha256 DIGEST of the file's bytes; __pycache__ excluded
